text.en: Steam Wand Froths Milk for Cappuccino

text.en: Dual Cup Brewing, 1-4 Cups at Once

applications.zh: 家庭, 汽车, 办公室, 厨房

description.en:
Our espresso coffee machines bring professional-grade brewing to your kitchen or office. The 20-bar pump pressure extracts rich, aromatic espresso with perfect crema, while the milk frother creates silky microfoam for lattes and cappuccinos.

Key features include a 1.5L removable water tank, 1350W fast heating, programmable cup sizes, and a compact stainless steel body. The intuitive control panel makes it easy to brew single or double shots.

We offer OEM/ODM customization: colors, branding, packaging, and even coffee accessories. MOQ 200 units, sample lead time 7-14 days.
description.zh:
我们的意式咖啡机将专业级萃取带入您的厨房或办公室。20巴泵压萃取出浓郁芳香的浓缩咖啡，奶泡器为拿铁和卡布奇诺打造丝滑微泡。

核心功能包括1.5L可拆卸水箱、1350W快速加热、可编程杯量和紧凑不锈钢机身。直观控制面板轻松制作单杯或双杯。

我们提供OEM/ODM定制：颜色、品牌、包装，甚至咖啡配件。最小起订量200台，样品交期7-14天。
